title: fm-fix-login-k3
summary: Carrying return_to through the OAuth state so SSO logins land where they started

findings.text: The loop only happens with SSO on: the callback drops return_to and falls back to /login
Reproduced it in a test (auth/callback.test.ts), failing as expected
Session cookie is fine; not a cookie-domain problem
